name: madar
description: Give your coding agent the repo context it needs before it starts searching. Madar builds a local graph of your TypeScript or Node.js repository and turns the current question into a small, task-aware context pack. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, Aider, and OpenCode can start from relev
